purpose: Metadata and source-supported annotation reservation before new pixels or scores
iip_source_exclusion: Satellite reporting source codes excluded even when marked VIS or R/V; inspect original provenance before treating sources as independent
iip_uncertainty_role: Conservative search allowance, not a calibrated confidence interval
split_policy: Preserve all prior development geography assignments; reject conflicts and original locked test geography/datatakes. New disjoint groups are training-only in this feasibility batch.
limitations: Source-supported opportunities are not SAR object labels. IIP source dependence, moving-target ambiguity, source accuracy and native pixel support require later annotation. Cross-era class confounding must be reported. No performance measurement or operational threshold selection.
